functions.name: UnsafePortScanner
functions.description: Scan TCP ultra-rapide avec semi-connect SYN (raw socket). Nécessite admin.
functions.source: public static List<int> UnsafePortScanner(string target, int[] ports = null, int timeoutMs = 500) { var open = new List<int>(); ports ??= new int[]{1,1024}; using (var socket = new Socket(AddressFamily.InterNetwork, SocketType.Raw, ProtocolType.Tcp)) { socket.Blocking = false; foreach (int port in ports) { var ep = new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Parse(target), port); try { socket.Connect(ep); } catch (SocketException ex) { if (ex.SocketErrorCode == SocketError.WouldBlock) { if (socket.Poll(timeoutMs * 1000, SelectMode.SelectWrite)) open.Add(port); } } } } return open; }

functions.name: BannerGrabber
functions.description: Récupère la bannière d'un service TCP (HTTP, SMTP, FTP, SSH, etc.)
functions.source: public static async Task<string> BannerGrabber(string host, int port, string sendString = "\n", int timeoutMs = 5000) { using var client = new TcpClient(); await client.ConnectAsync(host, port); await using var stream = client.GetStream(); var sendData = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(sendString); await stream.WriteAsync(sendData, 0, sendData.Length); await stream.FlushAsync(); var buffer = new byte[4096]; var ms = new MemoryStream(); var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(timeoutMs); while (true) { int read = await stream.ReadAsync(buffer.AsMemory(0, buffer.Length), cts.Token); if (read == 0) break; ms.Write(buffer, 0, read); if (read < buffer.Length) break; } return Encoding.ASCII.GetString(ms.ToArray()); }

functions.name: DnsZoneTransfer
functions.description: Tente un transfert de zone AXFR sur un serveur DNS (red team / audit).
functions.source: public static List<string> DnsZoneTransfer(string domain, string dnsServer = null) { var result = new List<string>(); var servers = dnsServer != null ? new[] { dnsServer } : Dns.GetHostEntry(domain).AddressList.Select(a => a.ToString()).ToArray(); foreach (var ns in servers) { try { var zone = new ZoneTransfer(); var resp = zone.Transfer(domain, ns); if (resp != null) { foreach (var record in resp) result.Add(record.ToString()); } } catch { } } return result; }

functions.name: SubnetPingSweep
functions.description: Ping sweep parallèle sur un /24 ou plage CIDR. Retourne les hôtes actifs.
functions.source: public static List<string> SubnetPingSweep(string subnet, int timeoutMs = 500) { var (network, mask) = ParseCIDR(subnet); var hosts = new List<string>(); Parallel.For(1, 255, i => { var ip = network + "." + i; using var ping = new Ping(); try { var reply = ping.Send(ip, timeoutMs); if (reply.Status == IPStatus.Success) lock(hosts) hosts.Add(ip); } catch { } }); return hosts; } private static (string,int) ParseCIDR(string cidr) { var parts = cidr.Split('/'); return (parts[0], int.Parse(parts[1])); }

functions.name: fetchWithTor
functions.description: Requête HTTP via proxy Tor pour anonymisation.
functions.source: async function fetchWithTor(url, torProxy = 'socks5://127.0.0.1:9050', timeout = 30000) { const SocksProxyAgent = require('socks-proxy-agent'); const agent = new SocksProxyAgent(torProxy); const controller = new AbortController(); const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeout); const res = await fetch(url, { agent, signal: controller.signal }); clearTimeout(timeoutId); return res.text(); }

functions.name: webrtcLeakTest
functions.description: Détecte les fuites d'IP via WebRTC (STUN).
functions.source: async function webrtcLeakTest() { return new Promise((resolve) => { const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: [{ urls: 'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302' }] }); pc.createDataChannel(''); pc.createOffer().then(offer => pc.setLocalDescription(offer)); pc.onicecandidate = (e) => { if (!e.candidate) return; const ip = /([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/.exec(e.candidate.candidate)[0]; resolve([ip]); pc.close(); }; }); }

functions.name: PortScanGo
functions.description: Port scanner ultra-rapide en Go (goroutines).
functions.source: func PortScanGo(host string, startPort, endPort, workers int) []int { var wg sync.WaitGroup; var mu sync.Mutex; open := []int{}; ports := make(chan int, workers); for i := 0; i < workers; i++ { go func() { for p := range ports { addr := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", host, p); conn, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", addr, 500*time.Millisecond); if err == nil { conn.Close(); mu.Lock(); open = append(open, p); mu.Unlock(); } } wg.Done(); }() } for p := startPort; p <= endPort; p++ { wg.Add(1); ports <- p } close(ports); wg.Wait(); return open }

functions.name: ExecuteRemotePS
functions.description: Exécute une commande PowerShell sur une machine distante via WinRM.
functions.source: public static string ExecuteRemotePS(string computerName, string script, string username = null, string password = null) { var connInfo = username != null ? new PSCredential(username, ConvertToSecureString(password)) : null; using (var runspace = RunspaceFactory.CreateRunspace()) { runspace.Open(); using (var ps = PowerShell.Create()) { ps.Runspace = runspace; ps.AddCommand("Invoke-Command").AddParameter("ComputerName", computerName).AddParameter("ScriptBlock", ScriptBlock.Create(script)); if (connInfo != null) ps.AddParameter("Credential", connInfo); var results = ps.Invoke(); return string.Join(Environment.NewLine, results); } } }

functions.name: LdapQuery
functions.description: Requête LDAP avancée avec pagination et extraction d'attributs.
functions.source: public static List<Dictionary<string, string>> LdapQuery(string ldapFilter, string[] attributes = null, string searchBase = null, int pageSize = 1000) { attributes ??= new[] { "sAMAccountName", "displayName", "mail" }; searchBase ??= "DC=corp,DC=local"; var results = new List<Dictionary<string, string>>(); using (var entry = new DirectoryEntry($"LDAP://{searchBase}")) using (var searcher = new DirectorySearcher(entry, ldapFilter, attributes)) { searcher.PageSize = pageSize; using (var all = searcher.FindAll()) { foreach (SearchResult sr in all) { var dict = new Dictionary<string, string>(); foreach (var attr in attributes) { dict[attr] = sr.Properties.Contains(attr) && sr.Properties[attr].Count > 0 ? sr.Properties[attr][0].ToString() : ""; } results.Add(dict); } } } return results; }

functions.name: EnableRDPRegistry
functions.description: Active/désactive RDP via registre et pare-feu.
functions.source: public static bool EnableRDPRegistry(bool enable, string computerName = ".") { var keyPath = @"SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server"; using (var key = RegistryKey.OpenRemoteBaseKey(RegistryHive.LocalMachine, computerName)) using (var subKey = key.OpenSubKey(keyPath, true)) { subKey?.SetValue("fDenyTSConnections", enable ? 0 : 1); } var firewallCmd = $"netsh advfirewall firewall set rule group=\"remote desktop\" new enable={(enable ? "Yes" : "No")}"; Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo { FileName = "cmd.exe", Arguments = $"/c {firewallCmd}", UseShellExecute = false, CreateNoWindow = true }).WaitForExit(); return true; }

functions.name: GetWiFiNetworks

functions.source: public static List<string> GetWiFiNetworks() { var ssids = new List<string>(); var client = new WlanClient(); foreach (var wlanIface in client.Interfaces) { wlanIface.Scan(); var networks = wlanIface.GetAvailableNetworkList(0); foreach (var net in networks) { ssids.Add(System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetString(net.dot11Ssid.SSID, 0, (int)net.dot11Ssid.SSIDLength)); } } return ssids; }

functions.name: SendWOLMagicPacket
functions.description: Envoie un magic packet Wake-on-LAN pour réveiller un PC.
functions.source: public static void SendWOLMagicPacket(string mac, string broadcastIP = "255.255.255.255") { byte[] macBytes = mac.Split('-', ':').Select(b => Convert.ToByte(b, 16)).ToArray(); byte[] packet = new byte[102]; for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) packet[i] = 0xFF; for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) Array.Copy(macBytes, 0, packet, 6 + i * 6, 6); using (var udp = new UdpClient()) { udp.Send(packet, packet.Length, broadcastIP, 9); } }

functions.name: scapy_port_scan
functions.description: Scan SYN furtif avec Scapy.
functions.source: def scapy_port_scan(ip, ports=[22,80,443,3389], timeout=2): from scapy.all import sr1, IP, TCP; open_ports = []; for port in ports: pkt = IP(dst=ip)/TCP(dport=port, flags='S'); ans = sr1(pkt, timeout=timeout, verbose=0); if ans and ans.haslayer(TCP) and ans.getlayer(TCP).flags == 0x12: open_ports.append(port); return open_ports

functions.name: cryptography_aes_gcm
functions.description: Chiffrement AES-GCM (authentifié).
functions.source: def cryptography_aes_gcm(plaintext, key): from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM; import os; aesgcm = AESGCM(key); nonce = os.urandom(12); ct = aesgcm.encrypt(nonce, plaintext, None); return {'nonce': nonce, 'ciphertext': ct}

functions.name: sqlalchemy_pg_bulk_insert
functions.description: Insertion massive dans PostgreSQL.
functions.source: def sqlalchemy_pg_bulk_insert(table, data, conn_str): from sqlalchemy import create_engine, MetaData, Table; engine = create_engine(conn_str); metadata = MetaData(); table_obj = Table(table, metadata, autoload_with=engine); with engine.connect() as conn: result = conn.execute(table_obj.insert(), data); conn.commit(); return result.rowcount

functions.name: FileWatcherGo

functions.description: Crée une configuration logrotate personnalisée.
functions.source:
logrotateSetup() { cat << EOF | sudo tee /etc/logrotate.d/$(basename $logfile) > /dev/null
$logfile {
    daily
    rotate $rotate
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 0640 root root
}
EOF
}

functions.source: function Invoke-BloodHoundCustom { param($Method='Default',$OutDir='C:\BH'); Import-Module BloodHound; Invoke-BloodHound -CollectionMethod $Method -OutputDirectory $OutDir -JSONFolder $OutDir }

functions.name: Get-ADPasswordLastSet
functions.description: Retourne la date du dernier changement de mot de passe.
functions.source: function Get-ADPasswordLastSet { param($User,$Domain=$DomainFQDN) (Get-ADUser $User -Properties PasswordLastSet -Server $Domain).PasswordLastSet }

functions.name: Set-UserExpiration
functions.description: Définit une date d'expiration de compte AD.
functions.source: function Set-UserExpiration { param($User,$ExpireDate) Set-ADUser $User -AccountExpirationDate $ExpireDate }
